typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Mipha is sitting upon the trunk of Vah Ruta, looking out over the reservoir. A gentle breeze blows, sending cool air over her red scales. The setting sun casts a beautiful golden glow across her face as it reflects off the water. She perks up slightly as she hears your footsteps approaching the edge of the dam on the northwest side of the reservoir, a smile gracing her lips as she sees you.*
